message.content:
The editorial illustration shows a person from the back, wearing a white jacket with a large tear down the center. The tear reveals crocodile-like scaly skin underneath. On the jacket, the letters "KPK" and "Komisi Pe..." and "...a Korupsi" are printed in black. The person's head and neck are visible from behind.

The image is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large, gray capital letters. Above the title are the words "JEJAK KORUPSI DI ASABRI" and "SALAH KELOLA LIMBAH MEDIS" separated by a slash. Below the title is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

Large white text reads "CICAK JADI BUAYA". Below this is a paragraph of smaller white text: "PENYIDIKAN SUAP ANGGOTA KOMISI PEMILIHAN UMUM YANG DIDUGA MELIBATKAN KADER PARTAI DEMOKRASI INDONESIA PERJUANGAN BERANTAKAN. KOMISI PEMBERANTASAN KORUPSI MALAH MENUTUPI JEJAK BURON."

The bottom left includes a black sidebar with "20-26 JANUARI 2020", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00048".
